subject: Microglia Shift Lysosomal Machinery to Protect Neurons From Degenerative Damage
script: From Agewell Brief: Microglia Shift Lysosomal Machinery to Protect Neurons From Degenerative Damage. Striking the CSF1R receptor to clear disease-associated microglia accelerates neuronal death, proving these immune cells deploy a GPNMB protein network to digest toxic brain debris. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
